messages:
julia: ACME reporting marketplace credits accepted on AWS but not reflected in our console. They accepted a Private Offer on 2026-03-15 and show 'Grant applied' on their end, but charges are still decrementing their trial. Ticket #12345. Anyone seen entitlement accepted but mapping not attaching?

sam: Seen that before with linked subaccounts under consolidated billing — ARN/account mapping mismatch. Can you paste the entitlement id + aws account id?

julia: Snippet from customer: entitlement_id: ent-0a1b2c3, aws_account: 111122223333, marketplace_offer: private-offer-acme-accelerator. They accepted 2026-03-15T18:02:12Z. Our ingestion webhook shows an incoming accepted event but our entitlement service returns 404 when trying to attach.

alex: I'll dig into delivery. @billing-bot can you requeue webhook for ent-0a1b2c3 and show last delivery status?

billing-bot: Requeue requested for ent-0a1b2c3 -> queued. Previous attempts: 3. Last_status: 404 MappingNotFound. Next attempt scheduled immediate on manual request.

julia: Customer also attached AWS screenshot saying 'Pending: Grant applied' and they urgently need credits — they're hitting token limits.

mike: From production logs: ingestion failed mapping because aws_account 111122223333 resolves to ledger acct 'acme-prod' in our system, while the entitlement references the purchaser root 999900001111 via consolidated billing. Reconcile job didn't find a matching ledger for the linked account. Proposed: 1) re-run entitlement reconcile for ent-0a1b2c3 2) if still fails, manual attach to customer ledger and escalate to AWS marketplace team to reissue entitlement against root account.

alex: Reconcile endpoint (internal, run with care):
```
curl -X POST https://ingest-api.redwood.internal/v1/entitlements/reconcile \
  -d '{"entitlement_id":"ent-0a1b2c3"}' \
  -H 'x-internal-call:true'
```

julia: I ran the reconcile with debug. Response: mapping_result: NOT_FOUND, candidate_accounts: [111122223333, 444433332222], reason: linked_account_owner_mismatch.

sam: If reconcile can't auto-attach, we can grant a temporary ledger credit to unblock. Need finance sign-off. @mike can you size the temporary credit? Also keep audit logs.

mike: Prepared estimate: USD 500 equivalent of accelerator credits to cover until entitlement attaches. Opened finance approval FIN-6789 and attached logs + reconcile output.

alex: I'm opening an AWS Marketplace escalation (aws-req-6678) asking them to re-issue the entitlement to root account 999900001111 and to trigger our webhook again. I'll include our audit ID and sample webhook payload for their ingestion team.

julia: Customer: "We need confirmation before EOD PST or we'll lose trial usage." I'll continue updates.

billing-bot: Delivery attempt 4 at 1924001890 -> status: DELIVERED. Mapping succeeded: attached to ledger acme-trial (ledger_id: led-7766).

julia: :tada: Credits applied and customer sees balance now. They confirmed tokens are available. Closing ticket after finance approval posts. Action items: mike -> post finance approval record and close FIN-6789, alex -> follow up with AWS to confirm root-account entitlement fix, sam -> add heuristic for consolidated-billing mapping to ingestion job.
